issue_title: Move the trace bearer-scrubbing into a named helper
issue_body: The trace writer scrubs bearer values from each captured line with an inline regexp replace. A second writer (the stage log tail) needs the same scrubbing next. Move it into one named helper in its own file with no behaviour change, and give it a direct test.

plan.summary: Move the trace writer's inline bearer scrubbing into scrubBearer in a new file, unchanged, with a direct unit test.

approach.description: Create scrub.go holding bearerRe (the same expression, moved) and scrubBearer(line string) string returning bearerRe.ReplaceAllString(line, "Bearer [scrubbed]").
In tracewriter.go, delete the package-level expression and the regexp import it alone used, and replace the inline ReplaceAllString with scrubBearer(line).
Add scrub_test.go with table rows for a header line, a lower-case bearer, a line with no bearer value and a line with two, splicing a placeholder value in so no row is a credential-shaped literal.

verification.test_strategy: The new scrub_test.go table plus the existing trace writer tests, which already assert a scrubbed header line.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Bearer scrubbing lives in one named helper the trace writer calls.
The trace writer's scrubbed output is byte-identical to before.

diff --git a/runner/cmd/fishhawk-runner/scrub.go b/runner/cmd/fishhawk-runner/scrub.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7f3e2a1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/runner/cmd/fishhawk-runner/scrub.go
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+package main
+
+import "regexp"
+
+// bearerRe matches an HTTP bearer value so a captured line never carries
+// one into the trace.
+var bearerRe = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+`)
+
+// scrubBearer replaces every bearer value in line with a fixed placeholder.
+func scrubBearer(line string) string {
+	return bearerRe.ReplaceAllString(line, "Bearer [scrubbed]")
+}
diff --git a/runner/cmd/fishhawk-runner/scrub_test.go b/runner/cmd/fishhawk-runner/scrub_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0b8d6c4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/runner/cmd/fishhawk-runner/scrub_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+package main
+
+import "testing"
+
+func TestScrubBearer(t *testing.T) {
+	// fake is spliced in so no row is a credential-shaped literal.
+	const fake = "PLACEHOLDER"
+	tests := []struct{ in, want string }{
+		{"Authorization: Bearer " + fake, "Authorization: Bearer [scrubbed]"},
+		{"authorization: bearer " + fake, "authorization: Bearer [scrubbed]"},
+		{"no value here", "no value here"},
+		{"Bearer a then Bearer b", "Bearer [scrubbed] then Bearer [scrubbed]"},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range tests {
+		if got := scrubBearer(tc.in); got != tc.want {
+			t.Errorf("scrubBearer(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.in, got, tc.want)
+		}
+	}
+}

false_alarm_examples.note: scrub.go: moving bearerRe could let a credential reach the trace unscrubbed.
